claim_label: Two Branches of Philosophy of Technology
description: The philosophy of technology has historically been divided into two main branches: a 'humanities' approach focused on societal impact and an 'analytic' approach focused on the nature of design and artifacts.

instances.assertion: The philosophy of technology has historically been divided into two main branches: a 'humanities' approach focused on societal impact and an 'analytic' approach focused on the nature of design and artifacts.
Technology has historically been viewed as both an imitation of nature and a distinct ontological category from natural things.

The philosophy of technology has historically been divided into 'humanities philosophy of technology' and 'analytic philosophy of technology'. The former focuses on societal and cultural meaning, while the latter focuses on the practice of engineering and the nature of artifacts.
